_comment: Layout rules for the glow-up deck lane. SOURCE OF TRUTH lives on GitHub (renderers/glowup/deck_rules.json). The n8n Director reads this to build a fully-resolved manifest; the renderer only paints the manifest. Edit here, push, and both sides pick it up. See ARCHITECTURE.md.

collage_rule.placement_note: matching pair sits on a diagonal (TL+BR and TR+BL), never as a top row over a bottom row
collage_rule.brightness_note: the two cells forming each diagonal must be within tolerance on the stored luminance column, so a near-black cell never sits opposite a white one. category variety is only a tiebreak among cells that already match on brightness.
